reader.requirement: END-SEARCH must delimit the scope of a SEARCH (both formats): statements after it in the same sentence or arm belong to the enclosing statement, an END-SEARCH closes the nearest unterminated SEARCH, a SEARCH ended by END-SEARCH may stand as an imperative statement inside IF and inside another SEARCH's WHEN or AT END arm, a stray END-SEARCH is refused, and END-SEARCH with NEXT SENTENCE is refused (SR5).

edition-consulted.switches: the END-SEARCH entry: reserved in all four editions

reader.edition-search: grep END_SEARCH/END-SEARCH/EndSearch over src/*.cs and *.g4; grep Edition/Version in ConditionalStatements.cs and ProcedureFormatPass.cs: none; the grammar's END_SEARCH? is edition-free.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover scope termination generally and SEARCH with NEXT SENTENCE; not exercised: END-SEARCH closing an inner SEARCH whose outer WHEN follows, nested SEARCH ALL ... END-SEARCH inside a WHEN arm, the SR5 refusal

probes.expected: scope ends at END-SEARCH; nested SEARCH ALL ... END-SEARCH in a WHEN arm; period-terminated with NEXT SENTENCE
END-SEARCH closes the inner SEARCH, whose second WHEN it is; the tail is in the outer arm
